component.name: Archivos
component.summary: Keyboard-first file manager with data previews and AI context tools
Gestor de archivos rápido con vista previa de datos y herramientas de contexto para IA

description.p: Archivos is a native Qt 6 / KDE Frameworks file manager built on KIO. It previews code, Markdown, images, CSV/JSON/Parquet tables (schema and statistics) and ML model headers (safetensors, GGUF, ONNX), builds context packs for LLM chats and exposes an MCP server so coding agents can see and safely act on the folder you are looking at.
